statement: Complete Smoothed TC Transport, Quantitative Vandermonde Block Detectability, and Honest Certification: For fundamental unit dilation period tau = 2*pi, coordinate scale h = tau^{-k} (k in Z), and smooth compactly supported test function phi in C_c^infty((0, infty)) with supp(phi) subset [a, b] (0 < h < a), the complete prime-zeta explicit formula transports faithfully across unit systems without coordinate defect: (1) Complete Smoothed Transport Identity: h * sum_{n >= 1} Lambda(n) phi(hn) = phi_tilde(1) - sum_rho m_rho phi_tilde(rho) h^{1-rho} - sum_{j >= 1} phi_tilde(-2j) h^{1+2j}, where phi_tilde(s) = int_a^b phi(x) x^{s-1} dx is entire. The trivial-zero series sum_{j >= 1} phi_tilde(-2j) h^{1+2j} is mathematically identical to the background integral h * int_1^infty phi(hx)/(x(x^2-1)) dx; exactly one representation is subtracted, correcting previous double-counting. The zero-point constant term -zeta'(0)/zeta(0) * phi_tilde(0) * h vanishes identically because phi_tilde is entire and -zeta'/zeta has no pole at s=0. (2) Quantitative Vandermonde Block Detectability: For any r distinct nonzero complex bases q_1, ..., q_r, the sequence S(k) = sum_{j=1}^r a_j q_j^k satisfies the block lower bound max_{0 <= l < r} |S(k+l)| >= c(q_1, ..., q_r) * max_j |a_j q_j^k|, where c = 1 / ||V^{-1}||_{infty -> infty} > 0. Consequently, hypothetical off-line modes (delta != 0, |q_j| = tau^delta > 1) cannot remain hidden across any block of r consecutive grades. Exact 2-mode and 3-mode Vandermonde coefficient reconstructions are formally proved in Lean 4 without axioms beyond propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. (3) Honest Fail-Closed Certification: Pairwise phase distinction is certified fail-closed for the first 25 zeros using Arb ball enclosures; bounded rational exclusion theta_j != p/q is certified for all 1 <= q <= 10^6 for the first 20 zeros via constructive Farey neighbor coverage intervals; and bounded integer relations (|a_j| <= 50) are certified with signed Arb witnesses. However, continuous distributional fluctuation does not force discrete lattice point collisions across arithmetic layers L_K = tau^K Z; the RH exclusion bridge remains open.

Gate 2 & 5 (Boundary Dominance & Asymptotic Limit Audit): verified quantitative Vandermonde block estimate max_{0<=l<r} |S(k+l)| >= c max_j |a_j q_j^k| across grades k=0..9; confirmed ratio max_S / (c*max_mode) is between 17 and 43 for off-line quartet (delta=0.25)

Gate 3 & 6 (Finite Vandermonde Cancellation & Mode Independence): proved that invertibility of V depends strictly on pairwise distinct bases (P2); formalized exact reconstructions in Lean 4 without extra axioms

Gate 7 & 8 (Bounded Rational Exclusion & Lattice Search): constructed Farey coverage witness brackets (a/b < lower <= upper < c/d with bc - ad = 1 and b+d > 10^6) for first 20 zeros, certifying exclusion of all denominators q <= 10^6; fixed sign of bounded relation witness a0 = 37 with Arb ball precision
